message: is no container ARIA names as a whole
$reason: A native button handed the name, with a `<textarea>` inside it. The button is a control by its own tag, and the text is another one a user lands on: one control holds another, and the text names nothing. axe reports `nested-interactive` on the button and `label` (critical) on the text in three engines. A control's kind is no licence for what stands inside it — only a container ARIA names as a whole owns its items — and the `button`'s presentational children spare only what no user lands on.
